Train 11-20 go west, 1-10 go east. Now let me write the dbt model. The model `trains` needs:
- train_id (from raw.train.id)
- direction (from raw.train.direction)
- run_east_and_has_less_than_4_cars: 1 if direction='east' AND car_count < 4
- has_more_than_2_long_cars: 1 if sum of CASE WHEN len='long' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END > 2
- has_double_sided_cars_in_3rd_position: 1 if exists car with position=3 AND sides='double' for this train
- has_rectangular_shaped_head_cars: 1 if exists car with position=1 AND shape='rectangle' for this train
- number_of_open_roof_car: COUNT of cars where roof='open roof', COALESCE to 0

Let me write this model:

<tool_call>
<function=write_model>
<parameter=name>
trains
</parameter>
<parameter=sql>
WITH train_info AS (
    SELECT 
        t.id AS train_id,
        t.direction
    FROM raw.train t
),
train_car_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.train_id,
        COUNT(*) AS car_count
    FROM raw.cars c
    GROUP BY c.train_id
),
has_long_cars AS (
    SELECT 
        c.train_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.len = 'long' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_car_count
    FROM raw.cars c
    GROUP BY c.train_id
),
has_double_sided_at_3 AS (
    SELECT 
        c.train_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.position = 3 AND c.sides = 'double' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_double_side_at_3
    FROM raw.cars c
    GROUP BY c.train_id
),
has_rectangular_at_1 AS (
    SELECT 
        c.train_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.position = 1 AND c.shape = 'rectangle' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_rectangle_at_1
    FROM raw.cars c
    GROUP BY c.train_id
),
open_roof_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.train_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN c.roof = 'open roof' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS num_open_roof
    FROM raw.cars c
    GROUP BY c.train_id
)
SELECT 
    ti.train_id,
    ti.direction,
    CASE WHEN ti.direction = 'east' AND tcc.car_count < 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS run_east_and_has_less_than_4_cars,
    CASE WHEN hlc.long_car_count > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_more_than_2_long_cars,
    CASE WHEN hds.has_double_side_at_3 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_double_sided_cars_in_3rd_position,
    CASE WHEN hra.has_rectangle_at_1 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_rectangular_shaped_head_cars,
    orc.num_open_roof AS number_of_open_roof_car
FROM train_info ti
JOIN train_car_counts tcc ON ti.train_id = tcc.train_id
JOIN has_long_cars hlc ON ti.train_id = hlc.train_id
JOIN has_double_sided_at_3 hds ON ti.train_id = hds.train_id
JOIN has_rectangular_at_1 hra ON ti.train_id = hra.train_id
JOIN open_roof_counts orc ON ti.train_id = orc.train_id
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call><|im_end|>

The model needs to join train and cars, and calculate:
1. `run_east_and_has_less_than_4_cars`: CASE WHEN direction='east' AND car_count < 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
2. `has_more_than_2_long_cars`: CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN len='long' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
3. `has_double_sided_cars_in_3rd_position`: CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cars WHERE train_id=t.cars.train_id AND position=3 AND sides='double') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
4. `has_rectangular_shaped_head_cars`: CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM cars c WHERE c.cars.train_id=t.cars.train_id AND c.position=1 AND c.shape='rectangle') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
5. `number_of_open_roof_car`: COUNT(CASE WHEN roof='none' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) with COALESCE to replace NULL with 0

Let me write the model:

<tool_call>
<function=write_model>
<parameter=name>
trains
</parameter>
<parameter=sql>
SELECT 
    t.id AS train_id,
    t.direction,
    CASE 
        WHEN t.direction = 'east' AND COALESCE(tr.car_count, 0) < 4 
        THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS run_east_and_has_less_than_4_cars,
    CASE 
        WHEN COALESCE(tr.long_car_count, 0) > 2 
        THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS has_more_than_2_long_cars,
    CASE 
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw.cars c 
                     WHERE c.train_id = t.id 
                     AND c.position = 3 
                     AND c.sides = 'double') 
        THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS has_double_sided_cars_in_3rd_position,
    CASE 
        WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM raw.cars c 
                     WHERE c.train_id = t.id 
                     AND c.position = 1 
                     AND c.shape = 'rectangle') 
        THEN 1 
        ELSE 0 
    END AS has_rectangular_shaped_head_cars,
    COALESCE(COUNT(CASE WHEN c.roof = 'none' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END), 0) AS number_of_open_roof_car
FROM raw.train t
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT 
        train_id,
        COUNT(*) AS car_count,
        SUM(CASE WHEN len = 'long' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_car_count
    FROM raw.cars
    GROUP BY train_id
) tr ON tr.train_id = t.id
LEFT JOIN raw.cars c ON c.train_id = t.id
GROUP BY t.id, t.direction, tr.car_count, tr.long_car_count
ORDER BY t.id
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call><|im_end|>

2. Calculate each of the derived columns

Let me write the model:

<tool_call>
<function=write_model>
<parameter=name>
trains
</parameter>
<parameter=sql>
WITH train_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        t.id AS train_id,
        t.direction,
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.id) AS num_cars,
        SUM(CASE WHEN c.len = 'long' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_long_cars,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.position = 3 AND c.sides = 'double' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_double_sided_at_3,
        MAX(CASE WHEN c.position = 1 AND c.shape = 'rectangle' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_rectangular_head,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN c.roof = 'open' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_open_roof
    FROM raw.train t
    LEFT JOIN raw.cars c ON t.id = c.train_id
    GROUP BY t.id, t.direction
)
SELECT 
    train_id,
    direction,
    CASE WHEN direction = 'east' AND num_cars < 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS run_east_and_has_less_than_4_cars,
    CASE WHEN num_long_cars > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_more_than_2_long_cars,
    CASE WHEN has_double_sided_at_3 = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_double_sided_cars_in_3rd_position,
    CASE WHEN has_rectangular_head = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_rectangular_shaped_head_cars,
    COALESCE(num_open_roof, 0) AS number_of_open_roof_car
FROM train_stats
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call><|im_end|>

Now I have a good understanding of the data. Let me write the dbt model. The model needs to:

1. `train_id`: from raw.train
2. `direction`: from raw.train
3. `run_east_and_has_less_than_4_cars`: 1 if direction = 'east' AND count of cars < 4
4. `has_more_than_2_long_cars`: 1 if count of long cars > 2
5. `has_double_sided_cars_in_3rd_position`: 1 if there are any double-sided cars at position 3
6. `has_rectangular_shaped_head_cars`: 1 if the first car (position 1) has shape = 'rectangle'
7. `number_of_open_roof_car`: count of cars with roof = 'none', replace NULL with 0

Let me write the model:

<tool_call>
<function=write_model>
<parameter=name>
trains
</parameter>
<parameter=sql>
WITH train_data AS (
    SELECT 
        t.id AS train_id,
        t.direction,
        c.num_cars,
        c.is_more_than_2_long,
        c.has_double_sided_at_3rd,
        c.has_rectangular_head,
        c.open_roof_count
    FROM raw.train t
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT 
            train_id,
            COUNT(*) AS num_cars,
            SUM(CASE WHEN len = 'long' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS long_car_count,
            MAX(CASE WHEN position = 3 AND sides = 'double' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_double_sided_at_3rd,
            MAX(CASE WHEN position = 1 AND shape = 'rectangle' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_rectangular_head,
            SUM(CASE WHEN roof = 'none' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS open_roof_count
        FROM raw.cars
        GROUP BY train_id
    ) c ON t.id = c.train_id
)
SELECT 
    train_id,
    direction,
    CASE WHEN direction = 'east' AND num_cars < 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS run_east_and_has_less_than_4_cars,
    CASE WHEN long_car_count > 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_more_than_2_long_cars,
    CASE WHEN has_double_sided_at_3rd = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_double_sided_cars_in_3rd_position,
    CASE WHEN has_rectangular_head = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_rectangular_shaped_head_cars,
    COALESCE(open_roof_count, 0) AS number_of_open_roof_car
FROM train_data
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call><|im_end|>
